description.value: Cedar Motel is a motel in Radium Hot Springs, BC, centrally located in the village and within walking distance of dining, shopping, and the famed Radium Mineral Hot Springs. Now operated by Prestige Hotels and Resorts since May 2021, it offers room types ranging from standard queen rooms to fully-equipped kitchenette units, plus a BBQ sundeck and guest access to the Prestige resort's pool, hot tub, and fitness centre. There is no on-site staff; check-in and key pickup are handled at the Prestige Radium Hot Springs Resort located a short drive away.

Notably, there is no on-site staff — check-in and all guest services are managed at the Prestige Radium Hot Springs Resort a short drive away.
